items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Musterhafen, Kaistraße 1, 27568 Musterhafen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026, sent by simple post. Per §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 21.05.+4 = 25.05.2026, but that day (Pfingstmontag) is a public holiday, so delivery is deemed to occur on the next working day, Tue 26.05.2026 (§108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month objection period starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB, §108 Abs.1 AO), i.e. 27.05.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number, Fri 26.06.2026 (§188 Abs.2 BGB). That day is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift applies. Final day to have the Einspruch received by the Finanzamt: 26.06.2026.
